items:
Just Listed new beach house in the Ivy Community in the heart of Inlet Beach. Timeless masterpiece of elegance and coastal luxury with a modern flair and ideally located less than 10 walking minutes to the sand! House is a 2,380 sq. ft. 4 bedroom (including double master suites with barn doors) bunk bed room, 4.5 bathrooms and 2 car garage. Three (3) King beds. Brand New community pool with private bathrooms!

Experience close proximity to some of the best shopping/dining experiences Rosemary Beach and 30A have to offer!

House Features:

Private fenced in yard with Weber Grill and outdoor dining table and seating areas and evening solar lights! A mile to downtown Rosemary, shopping and incredible dining options! Walking distance to the Donut Hole, Shades Bar & Grill, Shaka Sushi and Noodle House, Destin Seafood Ice Market 30A, Goatfeathers and visit a plethora of dining options at 30Avenue shopping center.

Great open kitchen that has everything you need to cook great meals. Brand new Pots, pans, bowls, dining ware, glassware, baking trays, pasta strainer, utensils are all available for you!

Wall-mounted Smart TV's in living room, ceiling fans in all bedrooms and upstairs sitting/gathering area. Two (2) private balconies with table and chairs to relax.

Double Master Suites (one on 2nd and 3rd floor) with en-suite bathroom, walk-in shower, double vanity and closet. There are two (2) additional bedrooms with King size beds and walk-in closets on the 2nd and 3rd floors with individual bathrooms (with tub) just outside the bedroom door entrances.

This is the perfect house for multiple families with a split floor plan on each floor for added privacy and relaxation.

2nd floor features a full size and twin bunk beds with Smart TV and attached balcony.

3rd floor features a comfy seating area with pull-out sleeper sofa bed, stacked washer/dryer and private balcony with table and chairs.

Each bed features 600 thread count sheets and great mattresses. House can comfortably accommodate 14 guests with 3 King beds, 1 Queen bed, bunk bed room and 2 sofa pull-out sleepers.

There are ironing boards and steamers for clothes and complimentary laundry and dishwasher detergent.

There is an outdoor shower with privacy wall/plants.

Inside the garage you’ll find ten (10) beach foldable chairs (w/ drink holder), beach towels, a large umbrella and a utility cart to help you transport your personal belongings to the beach.

Complimentary beach bags and coolers are also provide.

Finally, there are cameras in the front and back of the house for your safety and peace of mind.

If there is anything we’re missing, please let us know because our goal is to provide you with an incredible hospitality experience and make this house your home away from home!


Beach Access:

The house is located in the Ivy community next to S. Orange Street.

To get to the beach, exiting the Ivy community just make a right on Orange Street and it will dead end at Inlet Beach Access Point and W. Park Place Ave.. This entrance is the largest public accessible beach in Walton County where there are changing rooms, bathrooms and public outdoor showers. It is either a 2 minute car drive or 8-10 minute walk.

FAQ's:

Approx. 1 mile to Downtown Rosemary (amazing shopping/dining)
5 minute car drive to Publix Supermarket
Approx. 1 mile to Camp Helen State Park
Community Pool is only for residents and guests staying in the Ivy community
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is in the city center and on the waterfront. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and kayaking nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with mountain biking and hiking/biking trails.
